title: ESPC 2026 is coming to Amsterdam: Bringing Microsoft and the community together
summary: Join Microsoft at ESPC 2026 in Amsterdam to explore Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents, AI, and digital transformation.
body_markdown:
This November, the European Microsoft community comes together for four high-energy days of ideas, innovation, and connection. From **November 30 to December 3, 2026** , the ESPC Microsoft 365 and AI Conference will bring thousands of IT professionals, business leaders, developers, architects, and consultants to **Amsterdam** to explore what is next for AI-powered work.


As a **headline sponsor** , Microsoft will be at the heart of the experience—bringing product leaders, engineers, and experts together with customers and partners to share what is possible with[Microsoft 365](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/products-apps-services) ,[Microsoft Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot) , agents, and AI.


[Register for ESPC 2026](https://espc.tech/)


## Why attend ESPC 2026?


The modern workplace is evolving rapidly, driven by AI, automation, agents, and cloud-powered collaboration. ESPC brings together the people building these technologies and the professionals implementing them to help organizations transform the way they work.


**This year’s event at a glance** :


- More than 100 expert speakers
- 128 sessions
- 11 in-depth tutorials
- Nine dedicated content tracks
- Hands-on learning experiences
- Community meetups and networking opportunities
- An extensive expo showcasing the latest innovations


Whether you’re focused on Microsoft 365, Copilot,[Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software) ,[SharePoint](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/sharepoint/collaboration) ,[Power Platform](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform) ,[Azure](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us) , security, automation, or AI, ESPC offers practical learning opportunities for every stage of your transformation journey.


## Learn from Microsoft experts and industry leaders


We’re excited to announce that **Jeff Teper,** Executive Vice President, Microsoft Apps and Agents, will deliver the opening keynote at ESPC 2026.


As one of Microsoft’s most influential leaders behind Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft Copilot, Jeff has helped shape the way millions of people collaborate, communicate, and work in the era of AI. At ESPC 2026, he’ll share insights into the future of AI-powered productivity, the evolution of Microsoft 365, and what’s next for organizations embracing Copilot, agents, and intelligent collaboration.


Don’t miss this opportunity to hear directly from one of the visionaries driving the future of work as we gather in Amsterdam this November.


You will gain access to:


- Microsoft product makers and engineers
- Technical experts and executives
- Microsoft MVPs
- Partners and solution providers
- Community leaders and practitioners


## Discover what’s next for Microsoft Copilot Studio, Agents, and AI


Last year at ESPC 2025, Jeff Teper shared how organizations are adopting Microsoft Copilot, reimagining business processes, and creating new experiences through AI-powered agents and seamless integrations. At ESPC 2026, attendees will continue that journey by exploring how Microsoft Copilot, agents, automation, security, and AI at Work are transforming organizations across industries. See how organizations are moving beyond prompts and into business transformation with[Copilot Studio](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/microsoft-copilot-studio) .


At ESPC, explore how to build custom AI agents, automate workflows, connect enterprise data, and extend Microsoft Copilot to meet your organization’s unique needs. Whether you’re an IT leader, developer, or business decision-maker, Copilot Studio sessions will equip you with practical strategies and real-world insights to help you create intelligent experiences that drive productivity, innovation, and impact.


Expect practical guidance on:


- Accelerating Copilot adoption
- Scaling AI across the organization
- Building intelligent business processes with agents
- Strengthening governance and security
- Delivering measurable business value with Microsoft 365


[Join us at ESPC 2026](https://espc.tech/conference/espc-2026/tickets/)


## Build skills for the future of AI-powered work


ESPC is designed to deliver practical outcomes, not just inspiration. Whether you’re planning your first AI initiative or scaling enterprise-wide adoption, you’ll gain insights to help turn your digital workplace into a competitive advantage.


You will leave with:


- New technical and business skills
- Actionable strategies for digital transformation
- Deeper Microsoft Copilot knowledge
- AI adoption guidance from experts and peers
- Real-world implementation ideas you can apply immediately


## Connect with the global Microsoft community


What truly sets ESPC apart is its community. Beyond the sessions and tutorials, the event creates countless opportunities to connect with peers facing similar challenges and opportunities. From community meetups and informal discussions to networking events and expo experiences, attendees become part of one of the most passionate Microsoft communities in the world.


## Register today and save with early bird pricing


Registration for[ESPC 2026](https://espc.tech/) is now open, and[early bird discounts](https://espc.tech/conference/espc-2026/tickets/) are available for a limited time. Secure your ticket at the best price, plan your travel early, and get ready for four days of learning, innovation, and community building in one of Europe’s most vibrant cities.


Mark your calendar for Amsterdam from **November 30 to December 3, 2026** , and discover how Microsoft 365, Copilot, automation, and AI can help your organization thrive in the future of work.


## Ready to accelerate your AI and Microsoft 365 journey?


Join thousands of IT professionals, developers, architects, business leaders, and Microsoft experts at ESPC 2026 to gain practical insights, explore the latest innovations in Microsoft Copilot and AI, and learn strategies you can apply across your organization


[Secure your ESPC 2026 pass](https://espc.tech/)
